intent: Extract reverse_survivors, kcd2_dice_solver and focus_owner into their own public GitHub repositories with full history, and repoint every reference the monorepo kept - including the live kcd2 systemd unit.
scope: kcd2_dice_solver/ (73 files, 14 commits) -> github.com/kuhyx/kcd2-dice-solver, cloned to ~/kcd2-dice-solver
.github/workflows/reverse-survivors-ci.yml removed; each new repo carries its own CI
setup_kcd2_dice_solver.sh + lib/kcd2_autorebuild.sh repointed; the deploy script stays here
Non-goal: phone_focus_mode and the four system subsystems, which are separate steps
changes: Each unit extracted with git filter-repo --path-rename <dir>/: so it owns its repository root, preserving every commit that touched it.
Added a CI workflow to each: npm for reverse-survivors, pnpm for kcd2-dice-solver, flutter for focus-owner. The latter two had no CI in the monorepo at all.
focus_owner's two references to python_pkg.focus_policy now name the phone-focus-mode repo, where the generator is going. Regeneration of assets/policy.json stays manual and says why.

setup_kcd2_dice_solver.sh now builds from ${HOME}/kcd2-dice-solver instead of ${HOME}/testsAndMisc/kcd2_dice_solver, and its generated post-commit hook drops the `git diff -- kcd2_dice_solver/` path filter, which could never match again once every commit in that repo is solver code.
Repointed the live kcd2-dice-build.service user unit and reloaded systemd.
Added pnpm-workspace.yaml to the solver repo approving esbuild's build script - found by running the unit, not by reading it.

verification.command: npm ci && npm run check && npm run build (reverse-survivors, standalone clone)
verification.evidence: 100% statements/branches/functions/lines; vite build produced dist/ in 74ms.

verification.command: pnpm install && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build (kcd2, standalone clone)
verification.evidence: tsc --noEmit and eslint clean; 288 tests in 24 files passed; vite build succeeded.

verification.command: flutter pub get && flutter analyze --fatal-infos && flutter test (focus-owner, standalone clone)
verification.evidence: No issues found; 94 tests passed. Re-run after the two comment edits, same result.

First run exited 1: ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS for esbuild@0.25.12. package.json carried pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies but pnpm 10 reads the approval from pnpm-workspace.yaml, which was never tracked. Adding it fixed the install. This is exactly the failure that reading the script could not have found.
All three repos public on default branch main; reverse-survivors CI queued on first push.

risks: The kcd2 auto-rebuild git hook is installed into the solver repo's .git/hooks by setup_kcd2_dice_solver.sh; a fresh clone of that repo will not have it until the setup script is re-run.

focus_owner's policy.json is now a committed artifact whose generator lives in a different repo. Drift is possible if config.sh changes and nobody regenerates; the pubspec comment records the exact command.
The extracted repos were verified in a scratch clone, not in the working copies at ~/; only kcd2-dice-solver was cloned locally because a systemd unit needs it.
rollback: git revert the removal commit to restore all three trees and the reverse-survivors workflow.
Repoint kcd2-dice-build.service back to ${HOME}/testsAndMisc/kcd2_dice_solver and systemctl --user daemon-reload.
The new GitHub repos can be left in place; they do not affect the monorepo once the trees are restored.
